cards.name: [EPIC] Sprint 0 — Foundation & Governance
cards.desc:
# Objective
Establish the technical, architectural and organizational foundation of FlowDelivery.

# Scope
- Project governance
- Trello workflow
- Conventional Commits
- Branching strategy
- MVVM architecture documentation
- Design system documentation
- Environment and Supabase setup documentation
- Codex governance
- QA strategy
- Initial CI workflow

# Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Standards documented
- [x] Trello workflow mapped
- [x] Base repository structure created
- [x] Analyzer passes
- [x] Initial tests pass
- [ ] Remaining implementation tasks mapped

cards.name: [EPIC] User Authentication
cards.desc:
# Objective
Implement the base authentication flow for FlowDelivery users.

# Scope
- Login
- Sign up
- Password recovery
- Session persistence
- Auth state handling

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Auth flow defined
- [ ] Supabase auth integration planned
- [ ] Error states mapped
- [ ] QA scenarios documented

cards.name: [EPIC] Restaurant Feed
cards.desc:
# Objective
Create the main restaurant browsing experience.

# Scope
- Restaurant list
- Category filters
- Search
- Restaurant cards
- Empty and loading states

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] View model responsibility defined
- [ ] UI states mapped
- [ ] Data contract documented
- [ ] Initial QA scenarios listed

cards.name: [EPIC] Cart & Checkout
cards.desc:
# Objective
Implement the base cart and checkout experience.

# Scope
- Add and remove items
- Quantity update
- Delivery address selection
- Order summary
- Mock payment flow

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Cart state behavior defined
- [ ] Checkout steps mapped
- [ ] Error and empty states listed
- [ ] Release dependency identified

cards.name: [ROADMAP] MVP Portfolio Release
cards.desc:
# Objective
Track the minimum product scope needed for a polished portfolio release.

# Scope
- Foundation complete
- Auth flow
- Restaurant feed
- Cart and checkout
- Basic order tracking
- README and screenshots

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] MVP scope agreed
- [ ] Release risks mapped
- [ ] QA checklist created
- [ ] Portfolio evidence planned

cards.name: [ROADMAP] Delivery System Evolution
cards.desc:
# Objective
Plan the delivery tracking capabilities after the first MVP.

# Scope
- Order status lifecycle
- Tracking timeline
- Realtime updates
- Delivery history

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Data model drafted
- [ ] Realtime dependency evaluated
- [ ] MVP boundary documented

cards.name: [CHORE] Sync Sprint 0 cards in Trello
cards.desc:
# Objective
Synchronize real Trello cards with the local Sprint 0 board template.

# Scope
- Fetch current Trello cards
- Create missing cards
- Move completed cards to Done
- Keep pending cards in Ready or Backlog

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Trello auth available
- [ ] Cards created or updated
- [ ] Local board template matches real board state

# Dependencies
- Active Trello connection

cards.name: [UX] Add prototype PNG assets
cards.desc:
# Objective
Add UX/UI prototype PNG files to the repository as visual references for future implementation.

# Scope
- Add prototype PNG files to the appropriate assets or documentation folder
- Use clear and consistent filenames
- Reference the prototypes from relevant documentation if needed

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] PNG files added to the repository
- [ ] File location is clear and consistent
- [ ] Prototype files can be used as reference for future UI implementation

cards.name: [DEBT] Align roadmap template labels
cards.desc:
# Objective
Review roadmap template labels and keep them aligned with the Trello label map.

# Context
Some roadmap items use labels that must exist in the shared map before import.

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Roadmap labels checked
- [ ] Missing labels added to the map or removed from cards
- [ ] JSON validation executed

cards.name: [REFINE] Auth stories
cards.desc:
# Objective
Break the authentication epic into implementation-ready stories.

# Checklist
- [ ] Login story
- [ ] Sign up story
- [ ] Password recovery story
- [ ] Session persistence story
- [ ] QA scenarios

cards.name: [ARCH] Implement base navigation strategy
cards.desc:
# Objective
Introduce the initial app navigation strategy.

# Scope
- Decide routing package and app shell structure
- Document routing conventions
- Prepare implementation path for feature navigation

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Navigation strategy implemented or explicitly deferred
- [ ] Documentation updated

cards.name: [STYLE] Implement theme structure
cards.desc:
# Objective
Create the initial Flutter theme structure based on documented design tokens.

# Scope
- Theme entry point
- Light theme placeholder
- Dark theme placeholder
- Token usage convention

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Theme structure exists in code
- [ ] Analyzer passes
- [ ] Documentation remains aligned
